sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Fast-Casual Self-Serve Broth Bowl Master Licensing

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law foundation, residual French civil law influence, and Melanesian customary law; offshore International Company legislation follows common-law international finance centre precedents)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus, in force 2020)
World Trade Organization (Vanuatu Member since 2012; GATS commitments)
Vanuatu–New Zealand Tax Information Exchange Agreement (2011)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap 222] ss. 6, 10, 11 and 14; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 31 of 2022; Financial Intelligence Unit Act; VFSC AML/CFT Rulebook and directives issued by the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit; Sanctions enforcement under the United Nations Act [Cap 200].

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Incumbency of originating corporate entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National corporate registry of the foreign entity's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Vanuatu is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention; documents must be authenticated via the Vanuatu High Commission/Consulate in the country of origin)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized passport copies of proposed directors, shareholders, and authorized signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization via Vanuatu diplomatic or consular post

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference / attorney comfort letter for each Ultimate Beneficial Owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing licensed bank or retained legal counsel of the UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization followed by certification by a VFSC-licensed registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Chinese-language corporate registration and trademark records of the franchise master (PRC entity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: People's Republic of China State Administration for Market Regulation and / or China Trademark Office
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (PRC competent authority authentication followed by legalization at Vanuatu Consulate/Embassy in China)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, UK HMT Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Sanctions List, and VFSC sanctions notices; Politically Exposed Persons (domestic and foreign) require enhanced due diligence, senior management approval, corroboration of source of funds and source of wealth, and refresh screening at least every six months in accordance with the AML/CFT Act No. 31 of 2022 and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit directives for trust and company service providers.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Companies Registry – Name Reservation and Clearance Portal (vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be in English or Roman alphabetic script only; Chinese characters are not accepted for an International Company name. Names must comply with the International Companies Act [Cap 222] s. 11 and must end with 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', or an accepted abbreviation. The registered Latin-script name must not be confusingly similar to any existing company, foreign legal person, or protected franchise trademark; a Chinese trade name may be used as an alias only in parallel branding and must be transliterated consistently.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Group (without a demonstrable registered group context)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon written rejection, the applicant may file an administrative appeal with the VFSC Registrar within 14 days, stating the grounds of objection and a revised name proposal, under International Companies Act [Cap 222] s. 11(3) and Companies Act [Cap 191] s. 16; a further review may be sought from the Minister responsible for finance, followed by judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu. Re-application with an alternative compliant name may be resubmitted upon payment of the standard name reservation fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as the statutory registered office. A physical registered office in Vanuatu is mandatory and must be maintained by a VFSC-licensed registered agent with custody of statutory registers, the register of members, and the register of beneficial owners under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] s. 10. A virtual office address cannot substitute for this requirement. For the franchise-licensing trade, a local business licence and a substantive place of administration in Vanuatu are recommended to satisfy commercial substance expectations.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate: approximately 15% probability per annum of an unannounced physical inspection at the registered agent's premises as part of VFSC's compliance monitoring of International Companies and trust and company service providers; direct on-site inspection of the Chinese fast-casual franchise master-licensing business premises is unlikely unless a local restaurant trading licence is issued.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC International Company name reservation and availability clearance search
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under VFSC International Companies and Trusts Fees Regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC incorporation filing and Certificate of Incorporation (International Company)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: VFSC published fee schedule for International Company registration

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent initial service – registered office, UBO register, and statutory records (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark; mandatory engagement under International Companies Act [Cap 222] s. 10

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT customer due diligence, UBO piercing, and PEP/sanctions screening bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market fee for compliance with AML/CFT Act No. 31 of 2022 and VFSC AML/CFT Rulebook

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular legalization of PRC corporate documents and passport copies (including certified Chinese–English translation)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: PRC Notary Public, PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and Vanuatu Consulate/Embassy
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular fee schedules and certified translation market rates (no apostille available; Vanuatu is not a Hague Apostille Contracting State)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: External legal fees for franchise master-licensing scope review and International Company constitutional documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for offshore International Company incorporation and ancillary franchise scope advisory

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 170] of Vanuatu, ss. 8-17 (incorporation), ss. 20-23 (registered office and registered agent), ss. 24-26 (shares), ss. 84-97 (directors and officers).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - International Companies Registry, with the Far Eastern Counter in Hong Kong as the official filing window.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form A - Application for Incorporation of an International Company (VFSC-IC-1) together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; authorised capital of US$1,000 recommended; the sole subscriber share is issued fully paid to enable formation; no escrow or capital contribution account is required under Vanuatu law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscriber hereby subscribes for one ordinary share of US$1.00 par value, credited as fully paid, and that entry be made in the Register of Members. RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office of the Company be established at the office of the Registered Agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu, and the Registered Agent be authorised to maintain the statutory registers and company records. RESOLVED FURTHER that [Name] be appointed sole Director and [Name] be appointed Secretary; each is authorised to open bank accounts, execute commercial leases, and file the Food Business Licence and environmental registration. RESOLVED FINALLY that the common seal be affixed to the Memorandum and Articles and the Certificate of Incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry (Far Eastern Counter)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the VFSC name search request through a licensed registered agent, stating the desired name, two alternatives, and the franchise concept descriptor. The name must end with 'Limited', must not be misleading, and must not be identical or similar to a registered name; pay the search fee and obtain written clearance before lodging the application.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of subscriber identification passport
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused on grounds of similarity or prohibited connotation, amend the proposed name and resubmit on the same application receipt without an additional search fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Memorandum and Articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent approved by VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles of Association in the specimen form sanctioned under the International Companies Act, confirms the share structure, and arranges for the subscriber's signature to be notarised and witnessed in accordance with VFSC practice before delivery to the registry.
required_dossiers: Consent letters of proposed director and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notarisation or witness statements are defective, the documents are returned to the notary for correction and re-execution before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent submits Form A together with the executed Memorandum and Articles, consents of the registered agent and first director, and the government filing fee of US$300; the application is lodged electronically and in certified paper copy.
required_dossiers: Consent to Act as Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a query or deficiency note, the agent files a formal amendment within the statutory 14-day cure period without additional penalty; failure to cure leads to rejection with a refund of 50% of the fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar registers the company and issues the Certificate of Incorporation with a unique company number; the agent collects the certificate and certified extracts and verifies that names, capital, and officers accurately match the application.
required_dossiers: Certified registration extract / company search report
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the certificate contains typographical or legal defects, an application for rectification under section 15 of the International Companies Act is submitted to the Registrar for immediate re-issue.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Resolution and Statutory Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company registered office at the agent's premises in Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The sole director convenes the first board meeting, adopts the pro-forma resolution, formally allots the subscribed share, designates the registered office, appoints the secretary, and opens the statutory registers of members, directors, and charges; the secretary records the minutes in the minute book.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If board quorum is not satisfied or an appointed officer is disqualified, the meeting is re-convened and alternates are appointed by written resolution of the director.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Share Certificate and Corporate Kit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The secretary prepares Share Certificate No. 1 for the fully paid subscriber share, affixes the common seal, and delivers the corporate kit containing the certificate, memorandum, seal, and registers to the principal.
required_dossiers: Corporate kit inventory and delivery receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: In case of lost or defective certificates, the board authorises issue of a replacement certificate upon indemnity and recording of cancellation in the share register.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Department of Health - Food Safety Unit (Ministry of Health) in conjunction with the Port Vila Municipal Council for the municipal business licence.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Food Business Licence for an Eating House (restaurant) under the Food Act [Cap 91]; plus Port Vila Municipal Business Licence for 'Fast-Casual Self-Serve Broth Bowl Restaurant' under ISIC 5610.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology and Geo-Hazards
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B Environmental Registration (Pollution Control Permit); full EIA report not required for a grid-connected, sewered micro-scale food premises; separate trade-waste permit required for oil and grease handling.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Vanuatu national effluent guidelines (BOD5 <= 50 mg/L; TSS <= 50 mg/L; oil and grease <= 10 mg/L); mandatory grease trap with quarterly inspection; cooking fume extraction fitted with activated carbon filters for VOC and odour control; solid kitchen waste segregated for licensed municipal collection.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate issued by the Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Services following inspection of exits, extinguishers, and the commercial kitchen fire-suppression system; occupation clearance under the Vanuatu National Building Code covering structural load, sanitary drain connection, and workplace ventilation for the self-serve broth line.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila; official portal for customs declarations and tax e-services: https://www.customs.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a VU International Company (VU_IC): (1) incorporate through a VFSC-licensed registered agent and obtain the Certificate of Incorporation and IC registration number; (2) as an offshore entity the IC is not normally required to hold a VRC TIN, because it is restricted from conducting onshore taxable business; (3) if the IC imports goods or otherwise needs a customs/VAT client code, file a VRC registration application accompanied by the certificate of incorporation, registered-agent certificate, director and shareholder due diligence, and a statutory declaration confirming that all activities are offshore; VRC will then assign a VAT/customs taxpayer number.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone (Vanuatu International Company is statutorily exempt from domestic income tax, capital gains tax, and VAT on offshore supplies; the exemption is automatic under the International Companies Act 1993, not elective)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. Vanuatu does not provide a check-the-box entity classification election or any hybrid mismatch election. The VU_IC tax-exempt status is fixed by statute and remains effective while the company does not carry on prohibited onshore activity or otherwise breach the International Companies Act.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax Act No. 12 of 1998, as amended)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 of taxable supplies in any consecutive 12-month period; offshore royalty and licensing supplies received by the VU_IC from foreign franchisees are not charged to VAT, and a pure offshore IC is generally outside the compulsory domestic VAT net.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, API e-invoicing, or digital stamping mandate exists in Vanuatu. VAT-registered suppliers must issue prescribed tax invoices in paper or electronic form showing the VRC VAT number, description of supply, VAT-exclusive amount, and VAT charged; customs declarations are processed through ASYCUDA World, and VAT returns are filed on paper or via the VRC electronic channel without government clearance of individual invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to exports of goods and to services supplied to non-residents where the benefit is consumed outside Vanuatu, including offshore franchise royalty/licence fees paid by foreign franchisees to the VU_IC. The claim is available only where the IC can document that the service is supplied within an offshore arrangement and the supply is not consumed in Vanuatu; domestic onshore consumption is ineligible.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA-generated) covering the exported goods or the service underlying the royalty supply
Bill of Lading (or air waybill/other transport document) evidencing physical movement of goods out of Vanuatu where goods are involved
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice evidencing receipt of foreign currency export/royalty proceeds from the overseas franchisee
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRC may audit export documentation, inward remittances, and the offshore status of the IC. If a zero-rating claim is found to be false, unsubstantiated, or fraudulent, VRC may disallow the claim, claw back the VAT with interest, and impose statutory penalties under the VAT and Customs Acts, including monetary fines and custodial penalties for individuals who knowingly make false declarations; an IC engaging in prohibited onshore business may also lose its tax-exempt status retroactively.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) — the sole monetary authority and banking regulator; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) supervises International Companies under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]. The RBV administers no separate foreign exchange administration; exchange controls were abolished in 1988.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vatu (VUV) is freely convertible for both current and capital account transactions. No surrender requirements, no repatriation restrictions, and no prior central bank approval applies to inbound capital contributions or outbound dividend, royalty, and trade payments. The only documentary obligations are bank-level AML/CFT source-of-funds checks. Profit remittance is unrestricted, subject solely to the entity maintaining a valid tax exemption certificate and compliant contracts.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory timeline or mandatory conversion ratio exists in Vanuatu. All export or licensing proceeds may be retained in VUV or in any foreign currency at the company's unrestricted discretion. The RBV does not require periodic surrender or conversion reporting; only standard transaction-level record keeping applies.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility is Medium for royalty collection through offshore EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Mercury) as a supplementary clearing layer, but Low for capital escrow and primary treasury functions. Legal constraints: Vanuatu does not issue e-money institution licenses; offshore EMIs are not authorized by the RBV and cannot open VUV-denominated or Vanuatu domestic clearing accounts. Funds held with EMIs remain in foreign bank pools and may complicate VFSC substance reporting. Use an EMI only for low-value royalty aggregation, with automatic sweeping to an ANZ or BRED corporate account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statutory mandate requires directors to appear physically; the International Companies Act [Cap 222] permits fully non-resident directorships and remote incorporation. RBV AML/CFT directives allow remote onboarding via independent notarization and qualified video KYC interviews. In practice, all tier-1 banks request a video interview with the beneficial owner and at least one authorized director, plus notarized board resolutions and original certified passports. An initial 3-day presence in Port Vila by the Company Secretary or a local agent is strongly recommended to expedite account activation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreign UBO with ultimate parents in the PRC, combined with a Vanuatu International Company holding franchise assets in multiple jurisdictions, may trigger enhanced due diligence on substance and economic rationale.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]; VFSC Certificate of Good Standing; valid Tax Exemption Certificate; Memorandum and Articles of Association; register of beneficial owners filed with the registered agent; notarized passports of all shareholders and directors; bank reference letter from the UBO's home bank with six months of statements; audited or management accounts; a board resolution appointing the banking signatories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Franchise royalty flows from related Chinese operating companies to a Vanuatu exempt entity may be treated as a disguised financing or round-tripping structure for AML purposes.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed master franchise agreements and international licensing contracts; a transfer pricing benchmarking memo documenting arm's length royalty rates; the licensee's corporate registration and annual financial statements of the Chinese operating entity; underlying sub-license agreements and revenue summaries; tax residence certificates of the payor; a formal group structure chart with a written treasury purpose note.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large inbound capital contributions lacking clear economic purpose, exposing the account to Suspicious Transaction Report obligations by the bank.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Capital injection shareholders' resolution; source-of-wealth declaration with supporting asset disposal or dividend records; a detailed 12-month treasury cash flow forecast for the franchise build-out; evidence of the master license fee arrangements; and contracts between the IC and its franchisees demonstrating the commercial use of subscribed funds.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: route shareholder equity via SWIFT MT103 using the bank BIC of ANZ Bank (Vanuatu) or BRED Bank, with the payment memo 'SHAREHOLDER CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION – VU_IC – Tax Exempt under International Companies Act Cap 222'. The sending Chinese bank must record the remittance purpose as 'Foreign Direct Investment – Capital Contribution'. The receiving Vanuatu bank credits the Capital Escrow Account after completing standard verification; no RBV filing or approval is required. For credits exceeding the local enhanced verification threshold, attach the shareholders' resolution, notarized passport, and source-of-capital evidence to the bank's compliance team prior to crediting.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rail is SWIFT MT103 for B2B trade settlements, supplier payments, and royalty distributions. Corporate accounts in VUV, USD, or AUD are cleared through ANZ/BRED's global correspondent network; no foreign exchange control approval is required. For stock or equipment purchases supporting the franchise, a confirmed irrevocable Commercial Letter of Credit may be issued by ANZ Vanuatu in favor of Chinese suppliers, typically with a 90-day sight tenor. Royalty outbound payments to parent or sub-license entities require an executed contract, an underlying invoice, and transaction narrative 'FRANCHISE ROYALTY PER MASTER AGREEMENT' to evidence economic nexus.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Offshore non-deliverable VUV/USD forwards (NDFs) booked through ANZ or BRED dealing desks to hedge projected royalty inflows without requiring physical VUV settlement.
Cross-currency USD/VUV swaps executed as commercial hedging instruments under master ISDA terms with an approved counterparty, limited to the value of committed franchise fees.
Spot-forward combination packages with tenor up to 12 months, documented as full hedge of the net currency exposure arising from the Chinese sub-licensee payment cycle.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Annual License Fee Renewal (Vanuatu International Company under International Companies Act Cap 222)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), filed through the VFSC-licensed Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due annually by the incorporation anniversary date; VFSC administrative grace period of 60 days after the anniversary for the return, with renewal fee payable on the anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment surcharge of approximately 20% on the unpaid annual fee; after 3 months of continued non-payment the VFSC initiates strike-off proceedings, resulting in dissolution and vesting of the company's assets in the Public Trustee

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit for International Companies that do not carry on business in Vanuatu; an independent audit is mandatory only where the IC holds a VFSC banking, insurance, or finance-services license, or where the shareholders or articles require an audited report
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS (applied as national GAAP in Vanuatu) recommended; the IC Act obliges the company to keep adequate accounting records in English sufficient to disclose its financial position, but exempts ICs from preparing and filing statutory financial statements with the VFSC

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu maintains no public UBO register; under VFSC AML/CFT Rule 9 the Registered Agent must capture and maintain beneficial ownership records at onboarding and update them within 14 days of any share transfer; an annual written UBO confirmation signed by the directors and members is required by the agent when completing the annual return to verify that all share transfers during the preceding year have been recorded
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Beneficial Ownership Records held by the Registered Agent

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $750 – $1,500 per annum for an optional management-quality audit; nil for the generally applicable statutory-exempt International Company

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies (ICs) are exempt from Vanuatu income tax, corporate tax, capital gains tax, and withholding tax under the International Companies Act. There is no VAT, no payroll tax, and no social security contribution for ICs under current Vanuatu law.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Vanuatu International Companies Act: annual compliance filing (Confirmation Statement / Annual Return) via the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) registered agent portal. No income tax return is required for an IC because it is tax-exempt; only an annual agent certificate and government registration fee are filed.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual renewal and confirmation filing must be completed by the anniversary of the IC’s date of incorporation/registration with VFSC, or as otherwise stated in the VFSC annual renewal invoice. If the IC has a Vanuatu-source business (which it may not under the IC regime), a standard income tax return would be due within 12 months after the end of the accounting year, but this is generally inapplicable for an exempt IC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company name, registration number, registered agent name, registered office address, director details, shareholder/beneficial ownership details, and confirmation of no prohibited activities in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders and directors must ensure their full legal names, residential or service addresses, and passport/national ID details are accurately entered. A non-resident IC is not required to declare Vanuatu income, but must confirm it has not engaged in domestic business in Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identification of ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) holding 25% or more, including name, date of birth, nationality, residential address, and nature of control.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident UBOs must provide the same details exactly as held in source-country records. VFSC and the registered agent may request source-of-funds evidence for low-risk hospitality/franchise holding structures.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The licensed VFSC registered agent attests that the IC has complied with the IC Act, has maintained a registered office in Vanuatu, and has not undertaken any domestic prohibited activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident beneficial owner must instruct the agent in writing and confirm continued use of the Vanuatu registered office only for offshore administrative functions, not for a physical Malatang storefront in Vanuatu.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing or non-renewal of the annual VFSC confirmation triggers late penalties per the VFSC fee schedule; continued non-compliance can result in the IC being struck from the Register, a restoration fee, loss of the corporate veil, and possible director disqualification. Civil penalties and daily surcharges may apply under the International Companies Act and Financial Services Commission regulations.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for distributions by a Vanuatu International Company to non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreements (DTAs) currently in force. A Vanuatu IC does not pay Vanuatu withholding tax on dividends, royalties, or interest, so no treaty relief application is necessary for Vanuatu-source outbound payments. To obtain foreign tax credit or treaty benefits in the shareholder’s jurisdiction, the shareholder must obtain a Vanuatu Tax Residency Certificate (issued by the Vanuatu Ministry of Finance / Department of Customs and Inland Revenue, if applicable) or a letter from the VFSC confirming the IC’s tax-exempt status. The protocol requires: (i) written application signed by the company/agent; (ii) certificate of good standing from VFSC; (iii) statement of non-resident ownership and business activities; and (iv) payment of government certificate fee where required.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Vanuatu statutory withholding tax rate on royalties and interest paid by an IC: 0%. Treaty rates: not applicable because no DTA network.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory transfer pricing documentation threshold is codified for Vanuatu International Companies. Vanuatu has no general income or corporate tax regime, and ICs are exempt from income tax. Therefore, no local-file or master-file monetary threshold exists. However, if the IC is a franchise master-license holding entity deriving royalties from Chinese Malatang self-serve locations outside Vanuatu, the ultimate parent/beneficial owners should maintain OECD-compliant transfer pricing documentation in the operating jurisdictions (e.g., China, Australia, New Zealand) to support arm's length royalty rates and avoid foreign-country transfer pricing adjustments.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu’s International Companies Act prohibits ICs from carrying on business with Vanuatu residents or owning land in Vanuatu. Vanuatu applies substance-related criteria for exchange of information and beneficial ownership transparency: the IC must maintain a registered agent in Vanuatu and adequate records, and the beneficial ownership of the franchise royalty stream must be identified. For foreign anti-avoidance purposes (e.g., China, Australia, EU), the IC must demonstrate real economic substance—substantive management, employees, office premises, and business decisions outside Vanuatu where the franchise operations occur. The Vanuatu ESR regime is not a separate annual filing, but Global Forum and beneficial ownership transparency standards apply; a pure mailbox/booking-company structure may be challenged as a conduit or sham.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion in Foreign Operating Jurisdictions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu IC to book royalty income or franchise management fees earned from Chinese/Australian/new-market Malatang self-serve stores while failing to declare income in the source country, or retaining a Vanuatu IC as a shell/conduit to avoid foreign corporate income tax on active business profits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under foreign law (e.g., China’s Corporate Income Tax Law, Australia’s ITAA 1936/1997, or OECD transfer pricing rules), the taxpayer faces back-taxes, fraud penalties of up to 100-300% of the tax evaded in certain jurisdictions, interest on underpaid tax, and the denial of treaty/deduction benefits. In Vanuatu, neither the IC Act nor the VFSC will protect the owner from foreign tax authority exchange-of-information requests.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners may be personally assessed for fraudulent tax evasion, have corporate veil pierced if the IC is found to be a mere sham/conduit, be subject to travel bans and asset freezing, and face criminal imprisonment in source jurisdictions for tax evasion or money laundering.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Prohibited Domestic Business Activity (Vanuatu IC Act)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a physical Chinese Malatang self-serve restaurant in Vanuatu, conducting trade with Vanuatu residents, owning an estate or interest in Vanuatu land, or carrying on banking/insurance business through the IC without a separate Vanuatu local company or statutory license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine under the International Companies Act, revocation of the IC’s registration, strike-off, and liabilities for contracts entered into in Vanuatu. Government fees and prosecution costs may be imposed; the VFSC may disqualify the registered agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly allow prohibited local business risk criminal penalties and civil restitution; in extreme cases, the court may impose director disqualification, personal fines, and imprisonment for carrying on an unlawful business under the IC Act.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The Malatang franchise master-license IC holds a valuable trademark and collects royalty wires from fast-casual licensees, but has no office, no bank account, no employees, no decision-making records, no substantive IP-protection activity, and no economic substance where the royalties are earned; or the IC serves as an opaque layer to hide the true beneficial owner.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu’s international transparency obligations permit response to foreign tax information exchange requests, and the IC may be struck off for failure to file beneficial ownership. In source jurisdictions, the royalty income may be re-attributed to the beneficial owner under controlled foreign company (CFC) rules, with penalties of 50-200% of the underpaid tax. On a global scale, financial institutions may file Suspicious Activity Reports (SAR) under AML laws for shell-company royalty flows.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally liable for misrepresentation to VFSC or banks; the corporate veil may be pierced if the shell company is used as an instrument of fraud, leading to civil recovery from personal assets, travel restrictions, extradition risk, and imprisonment for money laundering or tax evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving franchise royalty wire transfers from counterparties with inadequate source-of-funds documentation, or failing to provide the Vanuatu registered agent/bank with accurate beneficial ownership and politically exposed person (PEP) declarations, or the royalties derive from sanctioned jurisdictions or organized crime-linked cash-intensive operations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Vanuatu’s AML/CFT framework (Financial Service Providers (Amendment) Act, Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act) the registered agent may terminate the IC; VFSC may impose fines, revocation, and the IC’s bank accounts may be frozen. Foreign anti-money laundering fines for unexplained wealth may exceed US$1 million.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors or UBOs found to control proceeds of crime face criminal prosecution, significant custodial sentences (up to 10-25 years in many jurisdictions), asset confiscation, and personal liability for the IC’s debts through fraudulent transfer piercing.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to disclose the Vanuatu IC and its royalty revenue to the beneficial owner’s tax authority under foreign asset and income disclosures (e.g., China’s Individual Income Tax annual report, Australia’s international dealings schedule, US FBAR/FATCA), or deliberately omitting the franchise fee/royalty from the controlled-foreign-company return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil fraud and evasion penalties, 75-150% of the understated tax, plus interest; criminal tax perjury charges in global jurisdictions; mandatory disclosure penalties for unfiled foreign asset forms can reach hundreds of thousands of USD; possible denial of passport renewal and immediate departure prohibition.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Individual beneficial owners (if directors) face imprisonment, personal fines, and punitive tax asset levies. The corporate structure provides no defense for tax fraud, and the Vanuatu IC’s limited liability is disregarded when the owner uses the IC to conceal income or evade tax.
